rules.requirement: Each night, choose a living player (different to last night): if executed tomorrow, they don't die.

assertingTests.name: the Devil's Advocate prevents tomorrow's execution death (BMR-DEVILSADVOCATE-01)
the Devil's Advocate's choice gets tomorrow's execution protection, and the next choice ends it (BMR-DEVILSADVOCATE-01)
a poisoned Devil's Advocate protects nobody but the choice is recorded and the last one ends (BMR-DEVILSADVOCATE-01, BMR-DEVILSADVOCATE-02, BMR-GOON-01)
the survives-execution dated effect is stored as the Devil's Advocate's protection for the next day (BMR-DEVILSADVOCATE-01)
a healthy Devil's Advocate records the choice and protects the player from tomorrow's execution (BMR-DEVILSADVOCATE-01, BMR-DEVILSADVOCATE-02)
